purpose: Bring existing JM1 CRM/Dataverse identity, prospect, relationship, referral, service, and pipeline data into alignment with the canonical BP-08 enterprise semantic model.
canonical_target_model: Service/support issue requiring tracked resolution = Case
Domain records remain domain-specific and link to canonical identity where evidence permits
migration_rules: Migration follows canonical meaning; canonical meaning does not change to make migration easier.
Preserve legitimate domain records; remove semantic duplication, not business history.
High-confidence matching may be reconciled only when canon and dependency proof permit.
Medium-confidence and ambiguous matches require Founder review.
archive_retention_rules: Legacy structures are retained read-only/historical unless a safe supported retirement path is proven.
identity_rules: Multiple division relationships are represented as governed relationships, not duplicate Contacts.
ambiguity_rules: No automatic merge for medium-confidence matches.
Founder & CEO remains reconciliation authority for ambiguous identities.
rollback_strategy: No live data writes were applied in this BP-11 execution; rollback is not required. Future write batches must capture before/after evidence and use supported Dataverse mechanisms.
validation_gates: relationship awareness without automatic consequential cross-sell
closeout_criteria: Deterministic evidence classified, unsafe writes deferred with reason, forward-state protected, manual queue bounded, and next package gated.
